title: ShouldaUsedThat evidence corpus
description: A public backing corpus of screened candidates and explicit problem-specific assessments used to build prior-art briefs; it is dogfood, not a universal catalog.

source_specifications.attribution: Repository-authored review records; individual entries retain any listed upstream attribution obligations.
Maintainer-reviewed personal-interest selections enriched from dated public repository metadata and documented ecosystem discovery sources.
Repository-authored problem definitions and explicit problem-by-repository assessments backed by public decision evidence.

collections.title: Generative AI & Agents
collections.description: Foundation-model tooling, inference, RAG, agents, evaluation, context, and multimodal generation.
collections.semantics: A durable domain collection for reviewed generative-AI and agent-system components and references.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when it directly supports a named model, agent, context, memory, inference, or evaluation need.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude hype-only discovery signals, closed model artifacts, and repositories without evidence for a named need.

collections.title: RAG, Search & Knowledge
collections.description: Retrieval, search, vector and graph stores, indexing, RAG, and knowledge systems.
collections.semantics: A durable collection for components that find, organize, connect, and retrieve grounded information.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository with a concrete retrieval, indexing, vector, graph, or knowledge-system role.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude generic AI frameworks without a reviewed retrieval or knowledge role.

collections.title: Computer Vision & Multimodal
collections.description: Image and video understanding, generation, geometry, perception, and vision-language systems.
collections.semantics: A durable domain collection for reviewed visual perception, generation, and multimodal systems.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when image, video, geometry, or vision-language work is an evidenced primary role.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude generic model tooling without a reviewed visual or multimodal use.

collections.title: Cloud Infrastructure & IaC
collections.description: Cloud provisioning, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, policy, cost, and local emulation.
collections.semantics: A durable domain collection for declaring, provisioning, testing, and governing cloud infrastructure.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository with a concrete cloud, provisioning, policy, cost, cluster, or infrastructure role.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude generic delivery tools without a reviewed infrastructure responsibility.

collections.title: Platform Engineering & Delivery
collections.description: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, developer platforms, release engineering, observability, and operations.
collections.semantics: A durable domain collection for building, securing, releasing, and operating software platforms.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when it has an evidenced delivery, platform, release, workflow, or operations role.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude generic libraries without a reviewed platform or delivery role.

collections.title: Software Supply Chain
collections.description: Testing, security analysis, dependency evidence, SBOMs, signing, provenance, and releases.
collections.semantics: A cross-cutting collection for evidenced software integrity and assurance controls.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when it supplies a named test, security, packaging, signing, or provenance control.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude generic security branding without a bounded, inspectable control.

collections.title: Python Engineering
collections.description: Runtime libraries, frameworks, packaging, typing, linting, testing, and developer tools.
collections.semantics: A cross-cutting collection for evidenced Python implementation and tooling roles.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when it serves a concrete Python engineering or learning need.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude language-adjacent repositories without a concrete Python role.

collections.title: Homelab & Self-Hosting
collections.description: Private cloud, networking, storage, media, monitoring, and personally operated services.
collections.semantics: A durable domain collection for software used to run personally operated infrastructure and services.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when operating a homelab or self-hosted service is one of its evidenced primary uses.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude hosted-only products and generic cloud tools without a specific self-hosting role.

collections.title: Creative Coding & Visualization
collections.description: Generative art, animation, interactive graphics, visual explanation, and data visualization.
collections.semantics: A durable collection for tools and references that turn code or data into expressive visual systems.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository with a concrete creative-coding, animation, graphics, or visualization role.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude generic UI libraries without an evidenced visual-computing or creative role.

collections.title: Nature, Physics & Simulation
collections.description: Artificial life, physics, agents, procedural systems, reinforcement learning, and simulation.
collections.semantics: A durable collection for software that models physical, natural, agent-based, or emergent systems.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when simulation of physical, natural, agent, or emergent behavior is a central role.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude general graphics or numerical tools without a reviewed simulation use.

collections.title: Web Engineering & Interfaces
collections.description: Browser and server runtimes, frameworks, routing, styling, rendering, and interface systems.
collections.semantics: A durable collection for building accessible, maintainable web applications and interface foundations.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository with a concrete browser, server, runtime, framework, routing, or styling role.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude template-only projects and unmaintained framework experiments.

collections.title: OSS Curation & Prior Art
collections.description: Catalogs, decision records, learning maps, native surfaces, and OSS evaluation tools.
collections.semantics: The product-specific collection showing the components, sources, and prior art behind evidence-backed OSS consideration.
collections.inclusion_rule: Include a reviewed repository when it is used by, evaluated for, or materially informs OSS discovery or ShouldaUsedThat's workflow.
collections.exclusion_rule: Exclude unreviewed discovery results and components without a documented decision effect.

popularity_treatment: Popularity is a dated discovery signal only; it never proves suitability, security, maintenance quality, or project fit.
non_ranking_disclaimer: This catalog records evidence-bound decisions for named needs and does not claim a universal best-OSS ranking or automatic adoption recommendation.
